tickerDurationSeconds: 240–1200 seconds, computed from the ticker text length
tickerBehavior: Slow continuous marquee; uses a fresh storage key to avoid older browser data overwriting the filled starter content.
contentNote: The 157 pre-existing curated records, 298 common-mantra starters and 367 editorial/study/prayer starters all have text and meaning. Editorial starters and study/ritual entries are labeled by entry type/source note and should not be represented as canonical scriptural mantra texts without review.
adminGate: Client-side demo only; production must use server-side authentication and a database.
imagePolicy: User-provided square 1:1 PNG images; no generated images
imageAspectRatio: 1:1 square image slots across hero, categories, mantras, articles, pages and daily mantra image areas.
